name: RustDesk Launcher
description: Opens a machine's RustDesk ID in the RustDesk app installed on this device, from the devices console on desktop, Web and phone. Self-hosted ID servers and their public keys are supported. Cognia passes the ID only: RustDesk asks for the password, and Cognia cannot tell whether the connection succeeded.

headless.reason: RustDesk opens on the device someone is using; a headless Host only keeps the binding for its paired devices (ADR-0234).
